description: cTab hardcodes its Android pages in cTab_fnc_updateInterface and raises no event when the page changes. This shows no cTab page in UKSF_ modes and raises uksf_ctab_modeChanged after every page change, so the uksf_ctab addon can show its app launcher and apps. The compiled .sqfc is removed because Arma loads it in place of the edited .sqf.

ops.replace: {(_display displayCtrl _x) ctrlShow (_x in _displayItemsToShow)} count _displayItems; ["uksf_ctab_modeChanged", [_display, _displayName, _mode]] call CBA_fnc_localEvent;
